newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Grajewo sets issue price at PLN 75-90.
newsitem.headline: Polish Grajewo sets issue price at PLN 75-90.

text.p: Polish wood panel producer Zaklady Plyt Wiorowych w Grajewie SA (Grajewo) set the issue price of its 550,000-share initial public offering at between 75 and 90 zlotys per share, the firm said in its issue prospectus.
It said the final issue price would be set through a book-building and announced two days before its subscription period begins, at the latest.

The firm, which seeks listing on the main market, offers 260,000 shares on January 20-21 in a tranche for large investors, 90,000 for small investors on January 20-24 and 200,000 shares for current shareholders on January 20-24.
It said it estimated its net profit at 19.2 million zlotys and sales at 232.9 million zlotys in 1996 and expected them to rise to 20.3 million and 266.3 million zlotys respectively in 1997.
Last year Grajewo had a net profit of 12.4 million zlotys on sales of 195.7 million zlotys.
